> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

Duplicate of #38077 — same root cause (read-path `Get-Clipboard -Raw` under `-NoProfile` emits the system ANSI codepage, decoded as UTF-8). #38077 covers the emoji variant; this is the CJK variant of the identical bug, same file/line (`ui-tui/src/lib/clipboard.ts`). The read-path fix is in flight as PR #37212 (mirrors the already-merged write-path fix #35222).

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

#### Summary

Six PRs address or reference this issue complex. #37212, #38090, and #54057 correct the affected PowerShell Get-Clipboard read path, while #35122, #35124, and #35222 address the opposite Set-Clipboard write path and therefore do not fix #53963.

#### Related pull requests

- #35122 **[closed]** `unrelated` — (+11/-2) — unrelated to #53963: the diff sets UTF-8 InputEncoding for Set-Clipboard writes, whereas the reported CJK paste failure is in the Get-Clipboard read path. The closed PR remains relevant as an earlier write-path fix superseded by the more robust base64 approach in #35124 and its integrated version #35222.
- #35124 **[closed]** `unrelated` — (+74/-16) — unrelated to #53963: the diff base64-encodes UTF-8 text for Set-Clipboard and bypasses stdin decoding, but leaves Get-Clipboard unchanged. The closed PR remains relevant because its write-path mechanism was incorporated into #35222 with authorship preserved in commit e6efa98.
- #35222 **[merged]** `unrelated` — (+75/-19) — unrelated to #53963 but relevant as the merged write-path reference implementation: it base64-encodes UTF-8 before Set-Clipboard, while the defective Get-Clipboard read path remains untouched.
- #37212 `fixes` — (+44/-9) — fixes the read-path cause by making PowerShell emit UTF-8 clipboard bytes as base64 and decoding them in Node. Despite the keep_open review on #37212, close it as a duplicate of #54057: both fix the same Windows/WSL Get-Clipboard corruption, while #37212 also adds an unref lifecycle change whose behavior is not asserted; its base64 transport remains a concrete salvage option only if the focused OutputEncoding approach proves insufficient.
- #38090 `fixes` — (+32/-3) — fixes the same cause by setting Console.OutputEncoding to UTF-8 before Get-Clipboard for the shared Windows and WSL command, with an emoji regression assertion. Despite the keep_open review on #38090, close it as a duplicate of #54057 because their production changes are functionally identical and #54057 carries the target issue's CJK-specific regression coverage.
- #54057 `best fix` — (+27/-3) — best existing fix: the focused diff forces UTF-8 stdout before Get-Clipboard on both Windows and WSL and adds a CJK-specific regression test matching #53963. Consistent with its automated keep-open verdict, retain this implementation through a rebase onto current main.

#### Duplicates

#38090 and #54057 implement the same OutputEncoding change; #37212 fixes the same read-path defect through UTF-8/base64 transport. Separately, #35122 and #35124 are competing write-path fixes superseded by the merged integration in #35222.

#### Suggested consolidation

Keep #54057 open with a salvage path as the best existing fix: rebase it onto current main while preserving the focused POWERSHELL_ARGS UTF-8 directive and CJK regression test. Close #38090 as a duplicate of #54057 because its production change is functionally identical, and close #37212 as another duplicate unless its base64 read transport is split into a focused alternative without the untested unref lifecycle change; #35122, #35124, and merged #35222 concern only the opposite clipboard direction.
